rules.H1_recovers: Straight line, true noise 0.10 m, no loss, every delay where median p95(told_5cm) - median p95(told_truth) >= 0.01 m: the adaptive arm closes at least 50% of that gap, and at 0.3 s its cell label equals the told_truth label.
rules.H2_no_harm: True noise 0.05 m (told_5cm is already right), straight line, every delay and loss: the median paired per-seed p95 difference adaptive - told_5cm is at most 0.01 m, and no cell goes from passes (told_5cm) to fails (adaptive).
rules.H3_no_turn_flip: 1 m turn, every noise, delay and loss: no cell goes from passes (told_5cm) to fails (adaptive).
rules.cell_label: a cell fails when at least half of its 50 seeds fail (p95 > 0.25 m or max > 0.50 m)
rules.verdict: worth proposing if H1, H2 and H3 pass; worth proposing only with a turn guard if H1 and H2 pass and H3 fails; not worth proposing as is if H1 or H2 fails.

design.statistic: per-condition median of per-seed p95 error (recovery arm only), order-statistic 95% interval, Wilson interval for failure rates, paired per-seed differences
